title: Design: An imported invoice line reads title - description in the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location, with Invoicing & payments - View.
  • Import a file made for this test, file A, from the downloaded Invoices import template (Settings, then Invoices under Data Import), with one Labor row dated today: a new invoice number (invoice A), an existing customer, *Line Title "Replace tie rod", Line Description "excessive play" and Tech Story left empty, so invoice A exists only as an imported invoice.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • Invoice A's labor row is in the file, and its ItemDescription cell reads exactly "Replace tie rod - excessive play", with nothing after "excessive play", as board 2.1 shows for a line imported from a previous system.

This case follows the design, which differs from the page: it is held and is not run until Product answers whether an imported invoice appears in the downloaded Customer Invoice report and how its line reads.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R12: “An imported historical invoice never reaches the live QuickBooks sync, so its line text is unaffected whatever the import wrote into it.”
  • Story 3, Prerequisites: “An invoice's line text is being produced, either by the live QuickBooks sync or by the downloadable Customer Invoice report.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.

References from Design

Design canvas "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Pz1Q6BfvreYFpQwVQZPTE6), copy re-read on 27 Oct 2026 (its one change since 13 Oct: the New Line board's "Title *" now reads "Title"): board 2.1 "Awkward inputs". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above, except where this held design case follows the design.

Board 2.1 lists a line "Imported from a previous system" among the tech-story cases that reach the books and shows it as "Replace tie rod - excessive play"; the PRD says only that an imported invoice never reaches the live sync and its text is unaffected whatever the import wrote (question 12, divergence DV-04).
